meta.title: 建议收藏！从零养成镜头拍摄思维
meta.title_en: Build a Shot-Framing Mindset from Zero

scenes.context: 要拍出有电影感的短片分几步？其实一步：把文字语言转化成镜头语言，靠分镜头脚本辅助完成。
sentences: Cinematic short films need one step.
把文字转化为镜头语言。
paraphrase: Cinematic short films need one step.
scenes.speak: Cinematic short films need one step. Turn words into camera language.

scenes.context: 不是要你去画分镜头脚本，而是要形成分镜头拍摄思维，在脑子里快速完成分镜规划。
sentences: You don't need to draw a storyboard.
在脑子里完成分镜规划。
paraphrase: You don't need to draw a storyboard.
scenes.speak: You don't need to draw a storyboard. Plan shots in your head.

scenes.context: 使用放大和百分之百还原这两个技巧，可以极大降低思考时间成本，提高拍摄效率。
sentences: Use the zoom and match-back tricks.
paraphrase: Use the zoom and match-back tricks.
scenes.speak: Use the zoom and match-back tricks. Cut your thinking time.

scenes.context: 确定人物在某个场景做什么：先稍微远一点看他在干嘛，再凑近一点看他具体在干嘛。
sentences: First shoot wide to see the scene.
Then move closer for the detail.
paraphrase: First shoot wide to see the scene.
Then move closer for the detail.
scenes.speak: First shoot wide to see the scene. Then move closer for the detail.

scenes.context: 「女生开心去上学」用镜头语言表达就是两个画面：先蹲拍全身远景关门转身，再中近景跟拍同样的动作。
sentences: Repeat the action in a medium shot.
paraphrase: Repeat the action in a medium shot.
scenes.speak: One sentence becomes two shots. Repeat the action in a medium shot.

scenes.context: 门其实没打开，只让演员假装关门走掉，通过动作的延续性让观众自行脑补。
sentences: Let the audience fill in the gaps.
Continuity of action sells the scene.
paraphrase: 用fill in the gaps换一种说法
Let the audience fill in the gaps.
Continuity of action sells the scene.
scenes.speak: Let the audience fill in the gaps. Continuity of action sells the scene.

scenes.context: 先拍拿衣服摊开挂上的中近景全程，焦点从人转到衣服，再远一点景别拍一次同样的动作。
sentences: Shift focus from person to clothes.
paraphrase: Shift focus from person to clothes.
scenes.speak: Shoot the full action first. Shift focus from person to clothes.

scenes.context: 除了基础交代动作，可以加艺术化处理：拍衣服随风飘动的镜头、把挂衣服的动作虚化在背景里。
sentences: Blur the background to highlight the subject.
paraphrase: Blur the background to highlight the subject.
scenes.speak: Add artistic touches. Blur the background to highlight the subject.

practice: 把文字语言转化成镜头语言。
First shoot wide to see what he's doing.
Let the audience fill in the gaps.
Shift focus from person to clothes.
pitfalls: 先学文字转镜头的分镜
镜头语言才是短片灵魂
以为分镜一定要画出来
分镜思维重于分镜画稿
用放大和还原降低思考成本
两技巧极大提升拍摄效率
用动作延续让观众脑补
省略让剪辑更有节奏感
